summary: Gone tower listed in Anne Arundel County. The state's Forest Service list names Long Hill there, not Hill Point. No build, staffing or fate sources found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what remains of the site.

notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list entry supports Hill Point. Two web searches and the local cache turned up nothing further on its build, design, staffing or fate. Record coordinates match the list. Hill Point is absent from the state's COMAR list of Forest Service towers and properties (Anne Arundel: Long Hill only), so ownership is unknown. The story is short because the evidence is short.
